routes.title: Continue direct 001E repair-to-pass
routes.rationale: This route optimizes for another local pass and repeats the 001B/001C/001D pattern of moving the collapse rather than testing it.

routes.title: Run 001E baseline-equivalence adjudication
routes.rationale: Faithful pair-count, two-token/full-bundle, serialized-state, graph/cache/count-table, and query-capable challengers should be added before any further repair. A tie should close as informative negative evidence.

routes.title: Close this Gate4 replacement task family as negative evidence and design a new Gate4 environment
routes.rationale: This is cleaner if 001E adjudication ties the candidate, but it has higher design cost and should follow an explicit equivalence closeout.

anti_zeno_rule: Do not attempt to tune 001D until it passes. First adjudicate whether simple faithful baselines tie the candidate; preserve ties as negative evidence.
